basic_info.description: Become completely enamored by this Gorgeous designer home in sought after Forest Knolls neighborhood! At the beginning of a sweet cul de sac, 1 Oak Park is a meticulous home, restored and updated by a family that absolutely loved living here. This love and attention to detail shows with every step throughout the house. Three gracious bedrooms and two baths (one ensuite primary) can be found all on one level on the upper floor. A smart pocket door separates these living quarters from a grand open-concept living room, dining area, and lux chef's kitchen. Large island for prep work and casual dining. Great entertainment space. Vaulted ceilings that ooze Mid Century architectural charm. Downstairs find a sexy family room with bar area that opens graciously to a deck and landscaped garden. Here you will find a fourth bedroom plus an office with closet. Laundry area found in hallway so no need to step into dusty garage! Two car side by side parking plus plenty of street space for guests. Abundant closets and storage. Media closet for all tech needs (house is wired for sound and internet). A gem of a neighborhood in the heart of the City. Easy to get to the Castro, West Portal and the Inner Sunset. Twin Peaks views and urban hikes. Seamless commute downtown. Fab neighborhood community!
